text:
Sam: Heads-up — NewGuard QBR prep. Onboarding triggered a token spike in the last 48h. We need a short cost mitigation plan + slides for Wed. @Chen can you drop spend snapshot & short forecast?
Chen: Putting numbers here — 48h token ingestion = 1.2M tokens/day peak, current avg 800k/day. If growth continues, forecast ~2.8M/day by next week. Back-of-envelope monthly run-rate @ current pricing = $7.8k. Link to snapshot: https://redwood.internal/reports/newguard/spend-48h
Maria: Renewal risk flag: customer is expecting predictable costs. They asked during onboarding for a burst policy and clearer guardrails. Capture ask in QBR: 1) burst allowance 2) best-practices doc 3) cost alert thresholds.
Ajay: Quick mitigation we can apply immediately: a soft throttle + budget alert. Example config we can push now:
```
routing:
  per_account_throttle: 120r/s
  burst_capacity: 250r/s
  budget_alerts:
    threshold_pct: [50,75,90]
```
This preserves UX but limits runaway token burn.
Onboarding Bot: NewGuard: onboarding step 3 complete — embed-heavy pipeline enabled, timeline: 2 days in prod. No infra errors.
Sam: Nice. Can we also capture qualitative feedback? They said model outputs sometimes include long bloated responses => likely prompt/template issue. Add to action items: prompt templates review in enablement session.
Chen: I'll add a 1-slide cost slide with current + conservative forecast and a mitigations list. Draft bullet: "Current spike driven by bulk batch inference during onboarding — recommend soft throttle + commit option for predictable pricing."
Maria: Suggest we offer a 3-month evaluation commit at a small discount to reduce renewal friction. Proposed: commit $20k over 3 months with overage at discounted rate. @Nina (Finance) — can we run margin impact quick?
Nina (Finance): Quick calc — if they take $20k/3mo at 10% discount, expected EBITDA impact ~ -$600 (small). Forecasted burn under commit reduces variability by ~65%.
Ajay: I'll stage the throttle and alert rule in staging for 10m smoke test then flip to prod. Will post rollout snippet and rollback command.
Sam: Action items — Sam: assemble QBR slide + send draft; Chen: attach spend chart; Maria: propose commit/offer; Ajay: implement throttle + alert; Nina: confirm finance blurb. Can everyone drop a single-line update here when done? :white_check_mark:
Chen: Done — uploaded slide to drive.
Ajay: Throttle staged, smoke test green.
Maria: Offer drafted, leaving comment for CS copy.
Nina (Finance): Finance blurb posted in doc.
Sam: Perfect. For QBR, include 1) snapshot, 2) mitigation we pushed, 3) proposed commit & business rationale, 4) enablement tasks (prompt templates + live walkthrough). I'll capture customer feedback during the call and post in this thread.
Onboarding Bot: Reminder set: QBR prep call scheduled Tue 10am — calendar invites sent to NewGuard and reps.
Sam: Closing — we'll reconvene if anything changes before Tue. Thanks team :pray:
